faq.caption: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions about PolarisDX and point-of-care diagnostics

items.question: Does the IglooPro pay off for my practice?
items.answer: With POC diagnostics you can offer biomarker measurements as a self-pay service directly in your practice instead of handing them to an external laboratory. You can transparently work out the utilisation and revenue this would generate in your specific case using the ROI calculator. This lets you see how the system fits into your practice structure even before you invest.

items.question: Is the IglooPro approved and quality-assured for use in a practice?
items.answer: The IglooPro is IVDR/CE-compliant and therefore designed for near-patient point-of-care testing (POCT). Across the entire measurement range the system achieves a precision of CV < 2 %, which supports reproducible results. Commissioning is carried out fully validated, so the quality-assurance requirements for POCT are accounted for from the start.

items.question: Am I tied to a single supplier after purchase?
items.answer: No. The IglooPro works across manufacturers, so you are not locked into a single supplier's tests. This gives you flexibility when choosing your test panels and protects your investment as your diagnostic needs change over time.

items.question: How much effort is it to integrate into our daily practice routine?
items.answer: The IglooPro is designed for use right at the chair and delivers the result in minutes, so the measurement fits into the ongoing appointment. As part of commissioning, we train your team in the measurement procedure and in operating the device. After that, we are at your side with technical support and ongoing care.

items.question: How quickly is the system ready for use after ordering?
items.answer: After ordering, your IglooPro is usually ready for use within 3–5 business days. We commission the device fully validated, so you can measure reliably from the very first patient. This removes the need for a separate, lengthy setup phase.

items.question: Which biomarkers can I measure depending on my specialty?
items.answer: The system covers specialty-specific panels for Dental, Beauty and Longevity – from Vitamin D and CRP through HbA1c to metabolic and inflammation markers. In dentistry, for example, the focus is on Vitamin D and inflammation values; in the longevity field, on monitoring metabolic and inflammation markers. Which tests make sense for your specialty is something we agree on individually during the consultation.
